title: Graded Exposure and Mindfulness Meditation for Patients Post-ACL Reconstruction
official: The GEMM Trial: Graded Exposure and Mindfulness Meditation for Patients Post- ACL Reconstruction
summary: To evaluate the effect of graded exposure and mindfulness meditation after ACLR, the investigators will determine the effect of graded exposure and mindfulness meditation to 1) decrease self-reported injury-related fear and reinjury anxiety, and 2) improve lower extremity reaction time when compared to a waitlist control group.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 14-35 years
* Have self-reported levels of fear on the Tampa Scale of Kinesiophobia-11 and the Photographic Series of Sports Activities for ACLR
* Injured their knee playing or training for sports (recreational or organized)
* Have a history of unilateral ACLR
* 6 months to 10-years post-ACLR

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of secondary ACL injury
* Do not exhibit elevated injury-related fear
* Concomitant surgeries at the time of ACL reconstruction
